body.statement: For every \(\vartheta\in\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(0)\), \(z=m+\beta+\eta\), where \(\eta\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2I_N/T_1)\) and \(\eta\) is independent of \(Y_0\). This law remains exact when the post factors are constant.
body.justification: The exact post-mean reduction isolates sparse decoding from post-factor variation without imposing a covariance lower bound.
body.gap: HeLiShiMiao2026 uses long-post asymptotics in its fixed-\(N\) result; this exact Gaussian reduction covers arbitrary \(T_1\), including constant post factors.
body.consumer: It supplies the post-period likelihood for simultaneous per-unit effect regions in the Jerusalem-conflict and Beijing-pollution analyses.
